The 1,520 pixels have a named cause. QSS-18. The prototype emits the Scope row as the label, the select, <span class="od-fill"></span>, then the action. od-fill is flex: 1 1 0: a spacer whose declared job is to take whatever width remains. The action is not drifting, it is being pushed, by an element written to push it.
And seven rows were never seven rows. QSS-15. The prototype builds exactly four .srow elements. Capture 01 shows those four wrapping. A reader of the narrow capture alone reaches the wrong conclusion, which is why both captures are in the folder.

Below 600 wide the label column narrows to 72 and the caps release to the content column QSS-88. Below 400 tall the limits statement withdraws QSS-48. Below 240 wide the pane states what it is.
The space to the right of the region is correct. QSS-38, and QLY-23 before it. At 1,894 pixels the region stops at 1,040 and leaves about 854 blank. What was wrong in capture 02 is not that the space existed, it is that the action walked across it.

B. Four control states

QSS-49QSS-50QSS-52QSS-55QSS-99QSS-104

Each state differs from the others by more than colour. Try the controls: the first two toggle, the third does not and says why.

StateMeaningRenderedSelectableAnnounced as
SelectedIn scope for the next scanyesyes{name}, {count}, selected
AvailableCould be in scope, currently is notyesyes{name}, {count}, not selected
EmptyNothing in the ontology to scanyesno{name}, none in this ontology, unavailable
WithdrawnIts vocabulary is absent from the censusnon/anot announced, because not rendered
Both captures render Empty identically to Available. QSS-50. Individuals 0, Object properties 0 and Data properties 0 look like live controls and cannot change the result of a scan. QLY-39 permitted that with a MAY while QLY-48 already forbade the same thing for a group chip, so the two requirements disagreed with each other.
And both captures make Withdrawn and default off indistinguishable. QSS-55. Of six groups, four are rendered. Retired entities is correctly withdrawn because owl:deprecated is absent. Publication metadata is default off under QLY-65, not withdrawn, and must appear as a control you can switch on. Both are simply missing, which is the collision QLY-74 forbids and never gave a presentation to.

C. The measure

QSS-40QSS-41QSS-43QSS-46

One rule: 72 characters a line, everywhere, with a pixel equivalent per type size. The two lines below are the same region before and after.

As built, 245 characters on one line

This scan checks what is asserted. It does not run OWL reasoning, judge whether a definition is correct, follow remote links, or load unresolved imports. Checks for a vocabulary the ontology does not use are withdrawn, never reported as passing.

As specified, 101 characters within a 440 pixel measure

Reads what is asserted. No reasoning, no definition judgement, no remote links, no unresolved imports.

Type sizeCapCharactersUsed by
12.5 px440 px72limits statement, vocabulary note, check count

The copy was shortened, not the measure widened. QSS-43. The clause that went is the withdrawal fact, because the Vocabulary row already states it and QLY-16 forbids stating one fact twice. Removing a duplication is what bought the two lines.

D. Four rows at every width

QSS-24QSS-32QSS-34QSS-89

The same region at 619 pixels, the width of capture 01. On the left as built, wrapping to seven rows. On the right as specified, four rows whose content scrolls. Drag either corner.

As built
Seven bands. Height depends on width, so no budget can hold.
As specified
Four bands plus the action line. 164 pixels at every width.
Why a rail rather than a wrap. QSS-34. A region whose height depends on its width cannot carry a height budget. QSS-26 is only enforceable because QSS-32 exists, and that is the whole repair to QLY-17.

Everything below 344 pixels in an idle pane is empty, and that is correct. QSS-76. Nothing has been scanned, so there is nothing to show. The distinction QSS-77 draws is between emptiness that reports a fact and emptiness that reports a layout failure: an idle pane with its action 1,900 pixels from the bottom edge is the second kind. Moving the action into the region converts it to the first.

F. The census row

QSS-53QSS-54QSS-59QSS-63

One row, not two. The withdrawal count is a control, and activating it names each withdrawn check and the vocabulary that removed it.

Vocabulary
Vocabulary
RDFSOWLSKOS

Withdrawn checks

  • Retired entity references, because owl:deprecated is not used here
  • Stated replacement for a retired entity, because owl:deprecated is not used here
  • Dedicated definition coverage, because IAO is not used here
Naming them is not a convenience. QSS-54. QLY-69 forbids gating a check that tests for something missing, because gating the license rule on Dublin Core would guarantee it never fires on the ontologies that most need it. Capture 01 says three checks are withdrawn and names none, so the capture cannot establish whether that rule is honoured. The three listed above are an illustration of the shape, not a reading of the build.

Status line6,172 classes
As specified: 6,172 classes of which 5,559 named and 612 definedEach count accounts for the other, and a later completeness percentage has a denominator a reader can check.
QLY-38 already states the principle this serves: a denominator the reader cannot account for is a denominator the reader cannot trust. QSS-65 extends it from the coverage report to every count in the pane.

H. What was superseded

QSS-4QSS-111

Six requirements in specs/quality/README.md, five of them written earlier in the same session by the same author against the same pane. Full quotations are in Appendix B.2 of the README.

SupersededByReason, in one line
QLY-17 four rows at 32, so 128QSS-24 QSS-26 QSS-32A budget that assumes rows do not wrap is not a budget.
QLY-18 chrome at most 136QSS-75It budgets the scanned pane and leaves the idle pane, which both captures show, unbudgeted.
QLY-21 the per region cap tableQSS-40 QSS-41A pixel table drifts as copy changes and silently omitted the limits line.
QLY-39 a zero kind MAY be offeredQSS-50 QSS-51The permission is what put three dead controls on screen.
QLY-45 the limits line is one lineQSS-44 to QSS-48One line without a measure becomes a 245 character line at a wide pane.
QLY-74 withdrawn and default off differQSS-49 QSS-52 QSS-55Correct, and never given a presentation, so both resolved to absent.
Three of the six share one cause. Rows 1, 3 and 5 are each a rule written on one axis with no counterpart on the other. That is the third time this suite has produced that failure. QSS-40 states the measure once for every region precisely so there is no second place to forget it.
